exposure: AI-based gamified mHealth intervention (GAIN MHI) without HCP engagement
AI-based gamified mHealth intervention (GAIN MHI) with HCP engagement
cohort: The study involved 2,880 disadvantaged pregnant women in Lebanon.
finding: Integrating healthcare providers (HCPs) into an mHealth intervention significantly enhanced antenatal care (ANC) uptake and improved maternal and neonatal outcomes in disadvantaged populations in Lebanon.
mod_finding: Normal deliveries decreased across intervention arms.
